profile_text: With a focus on construction and property management, this Düsseldorf-based real estate development company has achieved 13.5% growth since its baseline, driven by its specialized services in the German market. As a key player in the accommodation and food service activities sector, it has expanded its workforce to 42 employees in 2024, earning its classification as a Gazelle company. Its success is rooted in its expertise in developing and managing properties, catering to the demands of Germany's thriving hospitality industry.
